services.heading: Four things we make. One audit decides which.
services.intro: The audit sits last on this list and first in the work.

items.name: Branding
items.line: A brand people recognise with the logo covered.
items.body: We start with what your business is and who it is for, then draw the name, the mark, the colours and the voice from that. You leave with a brand your own staff can use without ringing us.

items.name: Websites
items.line: A stranger knows what you sell before they scroll.
items.body: Designed and built here, around how your customers move through it. Easy on the eyes, easy to use, and it feels like you on a phone as much as on a desk.

items.name: Videos
items.line: Watch it with the sound off. It should still make sense.
items.body: Brand films, launch films, and the short cuts that go out week after week. Written, made and edited under one director, so the story holds from the first frame to the last.

items.name: Images
items.line: Put it beside ten others. People should pick out yours.
items.body: Your product, your people and your place, made in one light so they sit together. For the campaign, the website, the feed and the wall.

items.name: The audit
items.line: One clear look at your business, before anyone makes anything.
items.body: We read your business the way a customer meets it and write down what it needs. It takes seven to ten days, and sometimes the answer is to change nothing.

addon.label: An extra, if you want it
addon.heading: We have our own AI system. We'll build one for your business.
addon.body: Our own content engine and our own build stay with us, because they are how we make our work. Yours is a separate system, made to your business and its needs, with several departments sharing one memory, and we run it for you.
addon.ruled_by_asif: 2 October 2026: we build it and run it for you; the studio's own content engine and build stay with the studio.

checks.heading: Five checks before it reaches you.
checks.intro: By the time you see a piece of work, it has been through all of these.

items.title: Strangers read it.
items.line: Read cold, with no background, to see if it stands alone.

items.title: It gets a mark.
items.line: Scored against a written standard. A low mark sends it back.

items.title: Three can say no.
items.line: One for taste, one for substance, one for ethics. Any one stops it.

items.title: Five try to break it.
items.line: Five attacks on it: the facts, the logic, the wording, the look, the claim.

items.title: One last look.
items.line: A director looks at it last, and signs it.

A_system_then_director.intro: The first four are run by our own AI system. The last is a director.
lines: Our AI system reads it cold, with no background on you.
The system scores it against a written standard. A low mark sends it back.
Three separate checks: taste, substance, ethics. Any one stops it.
The system attacks it five ways, starting with the facts.
A director looks at it last, and signs it.

B_people.intro: By the time you see a piece of work, five sets of eyes have been on it.
lines: People who know nothing about you read it cold.
A reviewer scores it against a written standard. A low mark sends it back.
Three senior people can each stop it: on taste, substance or ethics.
Five reviewers attack the facts, the logic, the wording and the look.
A director looks at it last, and signs it.

C_mixed.intro: Some of these are done by people and some by our own system. Each line says which.
